v0.2.8 Attribution Rules

Roster source: A Guard, Elementary Fall Guard, Fall Guard, Marching Band and World are normalized automatically. Known Table: imported only as additional evidence. Matching: SignUpGenius volunteer email is compared case-insensitively. One program = attributed; more than one = Multiple Programs; no match = Unmatched. The system does not guess ambiguous hours.
